ShaderNodePreset.Description: Use to turn a day exterior into a convincing night, with a physically-based night-vision colour response rather than a simple darken-and-tint-blue.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_DayForNight

Uniform.Tooltip: Input color space - sets gamma decode for the luminance model
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Master day-to-night amount (0 = day / identity, 1 = full night)
Uniform.Name: night

Uniform.Tooltip: Strength of the Purkinje luminance shift - how much reds darken and blues brighten toward rod vision
Uniform.Name: purkinje

Uniform.Tooltip: Residual saturation at full night (0 = monochrome night vision)
Uniform.Name: nightSat

Uniform.Tooltip: Output level at full night - day-for-night is darker
Uniform.Name: exposure

Uniform.Tooltip: Acuity loss - softens detail as night increases (rods have lower resolution)
Uniform.Name: softness

Uniform.Tooltip: Scotopic noise - animated grain that increases with night
Uniform.Name: grain

Uniform.Tooltip: Colour of the night monochrome (moonlight cast)
Uniform.Name: nightTint
